answer: Because the saffron height is fixed at intake and written down in the kernel receipt, the glacier audit and the replay can prove which state the answer was judged against. Answers are graded against a checkpoint at least 476 seconds old, so a submission cannot be scored against state it just changed itself. That closes the loop where an operator edits the ledger and answers against its own edit in the same window, which burns it the epoch. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
